title: Vigilant Feedback & Immediate Course Correction
description: The user actively observes execution, notices subtle omissions (e.g. tool not run, scroll leak, missing fields), and intervenes with sharp, exact course corrections.
ai_training_notes: When the user points out an issue, acknowledge it immediately, do not defend the mistake, identify the root cause, and rectify it completely.
satisfaction_driver: Speed and precision in assimilating feedback without repeating the same error.
